experience.title: Data Scientist
bullets: Saved clients time by letting them query their e-commerce data in plain English instead of menus or SQL, through an LLM Text-to-SQL pipeline (GPT API, prompt engineering) that generates executable SQL with 94% accuracy.

Helped clients find more prospective customers with a product feature that scores each visitor's conversion probability, using a machine learning model trained on user-journey data to flag high-intent visitors.
Surface irregular traffic spikes and dips across every site a client runs with an automated statistical anomaly-detection pipeline over web clickstream event sequences.
Process 100 GB of GA4 events per day in BigQuery with distributed PySpark ETL pipelines, turning raw event streams into analysis-ready user-journey sequences for clickstream analytics.
Built and maintain the Azure data layer (Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Blob Storage) that holds 72% of the company's operational data.
Cut manual server work by 65% by automating provisioning and maintenance with Bash, Azure Monitor, Azure load balancing and GitHub continuous deployment.
Develop 50 RESTful APIs and the backend services behind the company's website and app, load-balanced to serve concurrent users.
Informed the launch of an agriculture app for farms in India with a 21-page geospatial analytics report to the CEO on use cases, implementation paths and competitors.

experience.title: Business Analyst Intern
bullets: Gave a ~600-person business unit self-serve visibility into employee performance and department KPIs by gathering requirements from 4 departments and building Power BI dashboards.
Unified Snowflake and Oracle data for company reporting by designing SQL pipelines that transform source data into analysis-ready tables.
Traced budget variances and cost overruns to their root causes using statistical forecasts of monthly KPIs and spending built from historical data and the known client pipeline.
Let leadership track the company's financial health against plan by extending the billing report with quarterly budgets, performance targets and new KPIs.
Protected sensitive performance data with Power BI row-level security, so each lead and manager sees only their own team's metrics.
Mentored a supply chain intern from kickoff through delivery of a new reporting pipeline.

experience.title: Data Scientist Intern
bullets: Helped customers price cars against the market with less research time by improving prediction accuracy 62% with segment-specific models, luxury to economy, built in Scikit-learn and XGBoost with ensemble methods.
Saved $80k in external software costs and raised the dataset's predictive power by 27% by using the GPT API to extract structured features from unstructured car descriptions.
Automated collection of market car data with web-scraping pipelines into Azure Blob Storage, keeping the pricing models supplied with clean data.

experience.title: Data Science Intern
bullets: Explained the causes of processing delays for 68% of insurance claims using regression and hypothesis testing.
Showed which symptoms, diagnoses and claim factors drive processing time through 10+ Power BI dashboards.
Automated extraction, cleaning and transformation of health insurance claims data with an end-to-end ETL pipeline.
Delivered a standardized, analysis-ready claims dataset by filling missing and inconsistent fields with regression-based imputation.

experience.title: Research Analyst
bullets: Led three interns in evaluating $10k+ of BI tools (Power BI, Tableau, Zapier, AWS), recommending Power BI to stakeholders and negotiating vendor discounts of nearly 30%.
Gave multiple departments shared KPI dashboards by building a CRM-to-Power BI pipeline feeding 40+ data points.
Made dashboard figures match the CRM by reconciling data mismatches with added cleaning and transformation steps.

projects.title: ValAtlas: VALORANT Analytics & Win Prediction
projects.subtitle: Python, scikit-learn, PostgreSQL
bullets: Predicted round outcomes every 5 seconds with a win-probability model (logistic regression, scikit-learn) trained on 11,700 in-round snapshots from 1,127 VALORANT rounds, using players alive, spike state, team economy and engineered map-control features.

Reached held-out AUC 0.82, calibrated within 5 points in every decile, by preventing data leakage with match-grouped cross-validation (GroupKFold) and choosing logistic regression over gradient-boosted trees for more trustworthy probabilities.

Proved map control adds predictive value beyond basic game state with a match-level bootstrap (log-loss gain 0.0036, 95% CI 0.0008–0.0063), fixing the feature specification in advance after a first attempt returned a null result.
Engineered map-control features from walking-distance territory using multi-source Dijkstra on each map's movement grid, including per-site control and each team's distance to the planted spike.
Estimated the game server's lag compensation from the data (about 45 ms by regression, 50 ms by parameter sweep); correcting for it raised hits landing on the target's body from 82.5% to 90.4%.

Reported only metrics reliable enough to trust, testing 5 candidate aim metrics with within- vs. between-player variance and split-half checks and keeping 2 (crosshair height at a 15:1 signal-to-noise ratio).
Validated the data against Riot's official scoreboard (614/614 kills, 613/614 deaths) and caught a sign inversion that had a headline metric reporting 7% instead of 23.9%.
Built a physics-based jump detector from 125 Hz vertical velocity that found 117,000 airborne spans, 97% confirmed by a gravity-shaped velocity signature.

Built ETL from Riot's match API and parsed replays into PostgreSQL, extending an open-source C# replay parser with a Python (NumPy, SciPy) extraction layer over 600 MB–1.3 GB of raw events, about 2 million movement updates per match.
Shipped the analysis as a Next.js, Prisma and PostgreSQL web app with colorblind-safe map heatmaps, an aim-error target board and per-round win-probability timelines, backed by 235 unit tests.

projects.title: StockBot: Quantitative Trading Research Platform
projects.subtitle: Python, scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch
bullets: Designed and ran about 140 pre-registered strategy tests across currencies, US equities, emerging markets and crypto, each with walk-forward training, realistic trading costs and an untouched holdout period.
Guarded against multiple-testing bias using the Deflated Sharpe Ratio and combinatorial purged cross-validation.
Found a cross-sectional crypto ranking signal that held on unseen 2024–2026 data, with picks beating the average coin by 53% a year (t = 4.5).
Showed how backtests mislead: survivorship bias doubled an equity strategy's apparent return, and an ML stock model's "alpha" turned out to be market exposure.

Built point-in-time data pipelines from SEC EDGAR (XBRL fundamentals, 10,271 annual-report texts, Form 4 insider trades), FINRA short volume, the Binance archive (659 coins, including delisted ones) and FRED, BIS, ECB and CFTC macro data.
Fixed look-ahead and survivorship traps that would have inflated results, such as spin-offs recorded as stock splits and reused crypto tickers.
Developed machine-learning ensembles (ridge, gradient boosting, neural networks) and deep sequence models (LSTM, GRU-TCN, Transformer).
Built an event-driven modeling pipeline with CUSUM sampling, triple-barrier labels and meta-labeling.
Built a forward paper-trading system that logs each decision before its outcome exists, with a live local dashboard (Python HTTP server, Chart.js, exchange APIs).
Limited downside on a live OANDA trading bot with a daily loss limit, a drawdown kill switch and a spread filter.

projects.title: AI Resume Tailoring Application
projects.subtitle: github.com/YazenzM/resume-tailor
bullets: Built a Python and Streamlit application that rewrites resume bullet points against a pasted job description, with interchangeable Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini backends behind one interface.
Eliminated a class of defects where rewrites landed on the wrong role by constraining model output with a JSON schema and mapping every edit back by explicit identifiers.
Produced resumes that fill exactly one page with a Typst PDF pipeline whose automatic fitting pass measures the rendered page and adjusts body type size and content.
Reduced API cost on repeat runs by structuring the unchanging candidate profile as a cacheable prompt prefix, so only the job description is re-billed.
Prevented silent content loss from truncated model responses by repairing partial JSON and discarding incomplete objects.
Covered the result mapping, page fitting and response parsing with a test suite driving the real template and profile.

projects.title: Fantasy Basketball Roster Assistant
bullets: Built a fantasy basketball assistant that grounds roster advice in current reporting rather than static rankings, retrieving social media coverage of players through a RAG pipeline.
Integrated the Yahoo Fantasy Sports API to read live league settings, rosters and lineups so recommendations apply to the user's actual team.
Generated add, drop and lineup suggestions by combining retrieved player news with the league context pulled from the API.

projects.title: Brain Tumor MRI Classification
projects.subtitle: github.com/YazenzM/Tumor-Image-classification-with-ML-Neural-Net
bullets: Built and compared two convolutional neural networks in TensorFlow/Keras for four-class brain tumor classification over 2,870 labelled MRI images.
Constructed the image pipeline with Keras ImageDataGenerator, and applied dropout, early stopping and model checkpointing to control overfitting.
Evaluated ReLU against LeakyReLU activations across the same architecture, measuring the effect on training and validation performance.

projects.title: Rice Health Policy Hackathon, Houston, TX
bullets: Co-authored an 8-page policy paper on integrating ImmTrac2 into Texas's Health Information Exchange (HIE) to improve vaccine reporting, projecting a 32% efficiency gain.
Worked with healthcare professionals and analyzed immunization data to find record-keeping bottlenecks, recommending record sharing that reduces redundant vaccinations.
Presented findings to district judges and answered their questions, competing in a cohort of 100+ participants.

projects.title: ASA DataFest 2023, SMU
bullets: Placed 3rd by analyzing 10GB of data across 8 datasets, uncovering trends in pro bono legal cases for the ABA Foundation.
Pinpointed location-specific problems, such as high failure rates in Mississippi, through exploratory data analysis (EDA) in R with heat maps and distribution plots.
Predicted pro bono case success with 90% accuracy from response times and urgency indicators using a multiple linear regression model on NLP-extracted features.
